understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before restoring stamina. Walls prevent movement, and blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles respectively cycle the piece's shape, cycle its color through orange, blue, green, and red, and rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. A goal activates only when all three attributes match, and completing all goals advances the level; losing all lives ends the game.
